name: Mirai
summary: Canonical IoT botnet abusing default creds on cameras/DVRs/routers; spawned many variants.
related_papers: SoK: Security Evaluation of Home-Based IoT Deployments

name: VPNFilter
summary: Multi-stage malware targeting SOHO routers/NAS; linked to APT28; modular FW-resident stages.

name: Mozi
summary: P2P IoT botnet evolving Mirai/Gafgyt techniques against routers/DVRs.

name: Nexcorium (Mirai variant)
summary: Mirai variant via TBK DVR command injection (CVE-2024-3721); multi-arch; also Huawei HG532 CVE-2017-17215.

name: tuxnokill (Mirai variant)
summary: Mirai-like botnet exploiting D-Link DIR-823X CVE-2025-29635; also probes TP-Link Archer AX21 CVE-2023-1389.

name: CVE-2023-1389 TP-Link Archer AX21
summary: Command injection in TP-Link Archer AX21 web interface; widely exploited by Mirai-class botnets.

name: CVE-2017-17215 Huawei HG532
summary: Huawei HG532 remote code execution via crafted packets; perennial Mirai propagation primitive.

name: CVE-2024-3721 TBK DVR
summary: OS command injection in TBK DVR-4104/4216 via mdb/mdc args; used by Nexcorium.

name: CVE-2025-29635 D-Link DIR-823X
summary: Command injection in D-Link DIR-823X /goform/set_prohibiting; exploited by tuxnokill.

name: CVE-2022-27255 Realtek eCos SDK
summary: Realtek eCos SDK vulnerability impacting many OEM routers/APs; research PoCs public.

name: Satori
summary: Mirai variant adding zero-day/1-day router exploits including Huawei HG532.

name: Gafgyt/Bashlite
summary: Early IoT botnet family abusing BusyBox/telnet defaults; codebase reused widely.

name: CVE-2023-33538 TP-Link EoL routers
summary: Command injection on end-of-life TP-Link wireless routers; probed for Mirai deployment.

name: D-Link DWR-932B / 850L case studies
summary: Public multi-vuln case studies on D-Link LTE/home routers (backdoors, RCE, cloud protocol abuse).
